name: provider-anthropic
description: Gwennol's bundled model provider: the LLM_CHAT contract over the Anthropic Messages API, streamed and buffered. Everything that reaches outside the sandbox is declared here — one host_http.post per turn, to api.anthropic.com, with the api_key secret on the x-api-key header — and only the request shaping and stream translation run as guest code, which never sees the key. The guest module is filled in from crates/provider-anthropic by `cargo xtask bundle`; this file as committed is deliberately not registrable.

userFields.description: API origin, optionally with a path prefix for a proxy; trailing slashes are dropped. Any host other than api.anthropic.com also needs its own network:egress grant on this manifest.
Default max_tokens when the chat input names none: 16384 buffered, 65536 streamed.

A Messages API `thinking` object, sent verbatim (`extra.thinking` is the same knob by another route). Absent by default: no `thinking` field is sent and the model's own default applies — on, for current models — and the thinking blocks the vendor produces travel as the contract's `opaque` blocks, replayed verbatim on the next turn as the vendor requires. An explicit {"type": "disabled"} is refused by models that cannot turn thinking off.

Shallow-merged into the request body for keys the provider did not set itself — sampling knobs, `thinking` when the `thinking` field above is unset, and other vendor features the contract deliberately leaves to config.
Buffered turn: budget for the whole response (clamped by the host to 1 hour).
Streamed turn: longest gap allowed between chunks.

chat.description: One model turn per the LLM_CHAT contract. The guest builds the Messages API request and dispatches stream_turn or fetch_turn; the key never enters the guest.

fetch_turn.description: A buffered Messages API request. Input: {url, request}, both built by the guest — the URL from $config.base_url with trailing slashes dropped; which host it may reach is the network:egress grant above, not the input. Output: {status, body, truncated} for the guest to translate.

stream_turn.description: A streamed Messages API request relayed as contract NDJSON. Input: {url, request}, as for fetch_turn. The relay's output is the stream handle chat returns.
